output_format.description: Output format flag for swetest (e.g., 'b' for binary, 'c' for CSV, 'm' for mnesia).

date.description: The date for the ephemeris calculation. Can be a Julian Day number or a date string.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude for geocentric calculations in degrees.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude for geocentric calculations in degrees.

timezone.description: Time zone offset from UTC in hours.

bodies.description: List of celestial bodies to calculate positions for. Corresponds to -p flag values.

output_file.description: Output file path. '/' indicates standard output.
